home.title: Hospitality That Works as Hard as You Do
intro: Akea HMS is a family‑owned and operated, full‑service hospitality management company dedicated to building exceptional hotels and elevating the guest experience across every property we lead. With deep roots in the industry and a hands‑on ownership approach, we specialize in hotel development, day‑to‑day operations, and strategic asset management.

We bring together the discipline of performance, the heart of family values, and the precision of modern hospitality systems. Our portfolio spans multiple brands and markets, unified by a commitment to operational excellence, strong partnerships, and long‑term value creation. Whether developing new projects or optimizing existing assets, we focus on delivering results that owners trust, teams rely on, and guests remember.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

cookie-policy.title: Cookie Policy
cookie-policy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Akea HMS (“we,” “our,” or “us”) uses cookies and similar technologies on our website. By continuing to browse or use our website, you consent to our use of cookies in accordance with this policy.
sections: What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites function efficiently, remember user preferences, and provide analytical insights to improve user experience.
How We Use Cookies?

We use cookies to ensure proper website functionality, improve performance, analyze website traffic, and enhance user experience. Cookies allow us to understand how visitors interact with our website so we can improve content and usability.
Types of Cookies We Use

We may use essential cookies that are necessary for the operation of the website. These cookies enable basic functions such as page navigation and secure access to website features. We may also use performance and analytics cookies to collect information about how visitors use our website. This data is aggregated and anonymous and helps us improve site functionality. In some cases, functionality cookies may be used to remember user preferences and settings for a more personalized browsing experience.
Managing Cookies

You can choose to accept or decline cookies through your browser settings. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can modify your settings to decline cookies if you prefer. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of certain parts of the website.
Third-Party Cookies

Our website may use third-party services, such as analytics tools, that set their own cookies to collect information about website usage. Akea HMS does not control these cookies and encourages you to review the privacy policies of third-party providers.
Changes to This Cookie Policy

We reserve the right to update or modify this Cookie Policy at any time. Any changes will be effective upon posting on this page. Continued use of the website indicates acceptance of the revised policy.
